item.createthaumicmagics.thaumic_enginee: Reveals Thaumcraft nodes and aspects; shows Create's goggles HUD.
tc.research_text.CTM_THAUMIC_ENGINEERING: Create's precision mechanisms can be adapted to the manipulation of Vis and arcane devices.
tc.research_page.CTM_THAUMIC_ENGINEERING: Infusion reveals a new path: combining the reliable motion of Create with the principles of Thaumcraft.
tc.research_text.CTM_ENGINEER_GOGGLES: A union of revealing lenses and engineer's optics lets you perceive both arcane phenomena and the workings of machinery.
tc.research_page.CTM_ENGINEER_GOGGLES.1: Combine the Goggles of Revealing and Engineer's Goggles with two Thaumic Brass Sheets and two Thaumium Sheets on an Arcane Workbench. Their order determines which lens arrangement is preserved.
tc.research_text.CTM_THAUMOSTATIC_BLAZE_: A precise rotary assembly channels Ignis essentia and Vis into a controllable source of intense heat.
tc.research_page.CTM_THAUMOSTATIC_BLAZE_: Infuse an empty Create Blaze Burner with four Thaumium Sheets, two Thaumic Brass Ingots, Ignis, Praecisio, and Rotatio.
tc.research_text.CTM_THAUMIC_STOCK_CRAFT: An infusion-enhanced stock crafter can perform arcane crafting when supplied with a wand.
tc.research_page.CTM_THAUMIC_STOCK_CRAFT: Infuse a Stock Crafter with four Thaumic Brass Sheets, two Thaumium Sheets, an Arcane Worktable, Praecisio, Cognitio, and Ordo.
tc.research_text.CTM_WIRELESS_THAUMIC_ST: The arcane crafting interface can be brought to a linked Create stock network.
tc.research_page.CTM_WIRELESS_THAUMIC_ST: Infuse a Wireless Stock Crafter to connect its remote terminal to Thaumcraft's arcane recipes.
